## Initial Release

First public release of the JDownloader 2 Docker image for Unraid.

## Features

- **KasmVNC web interface** — full JDownloader 2 GUI in the browser, no VNC client needed
- **Hardware-accelerated rendering** — built on `linuxserver/baseimage-kasmvnc:ubuntunoble`
- **Modern dark interface** — JD_Plain_Dark theme with Breeze Dark colour palette pre-applied
- **Java 21 JRE** — full AWT/Swing support, not headless
- **Auto-install on first start** — downloads and installs JDownloader 2 automatically, no manual setup
- **Self-updating** — JDownloader updates itself on every container start
- **17 UI languages** — selectable via `JD_LANG` dropdown in the Unraid template
- **Multi-arch** — amd64 and arm64
- **Update-safe config** — all settings, links and session state in `/config`, survive every `docker pull`
- **Unraid Community Applications template** — one-click install via the CA plugin

## Configuration

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `JD_LANG` | `de` | UI language (de, en, fr, es, it, pt, nl, pl, cs, sk, hu, ro, ru, tr, ja, ko, zh) |
| `JD_DARK_MODE` | `true` | `true` = dark (JD_Plain_Dark), `false` = light |
| `PUID` / `PGID` | `99` / `100` | User/Group ID (Unraid: nobody/users) |
| `TZ` | `Europe/Vienna` | Timezone |

| Port | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `3000` | KasmVNC HTTP |
| `3001` | KasmVNC HTTPS (self-signed) |
